info.title: WeTalk Web API Contract
info.description:
This contract covers all 43 current backend REST endpoints used by WeTalkApp and the planned WeTalkWeb client. WebSocket frames and production deployment settings are documented separately.

Requests use application/x-www-form-urlencoded and the same-origin /api prefix unless an operation specifies multipart/form-data or a binary response. Business errors are normally returned in the BaseResponse body, often with HTTP 200; clients must inspect code. Login sends a lowercase MD5 digest for compatibility with the existing Electron client, while registration and password change send the raw password over HTTPS and the server hashes it. This legacy protocol must be replaced before public production use. Backend 0.0.2 marks the password field write-only, and its serialization test verifies the password is omitted from JSON. A live admin-role endpoint check remains a separate integration item.

servers.description: Same-origin API path. In local development, Vite proxies /api to the Spring Boot service on port 5050.

post.description: Creates a short-lived captcha and returns its image data URI and one-time key. The key expires after ten minutes and is consumed by registration or login. The backend mapping currently accepts an unrestricted HTTP method; WeTalkWeb uses POST.

200.description: Captcha created.

post.description: The server hashes the submitted password. Password constraints are copied from the current backend validation rule. Email ownership is not verified by the current backend.

200.description: Registration result. Inspect code for business success or failure.

post.description: For compatibility with WeTalkApp, the login password field contains the 32-character lowercase MD5 digest of the password, not the raw password. This is a legacy protocol; it is not a production-grade password transport design.

200.description: Login result. A successful response includes a token and user summary.
Current profile for the authenticated token.

post.description: The request contains the raw new password; the backend hashes it and forces the active user offline. Send this only over HTTPS in production.

password.description: Raw new password. Must contain at least one letter and one digit.

200.description: Password changed; data is null.
Logout completed; data is null.
System settings returned by the current backend configuration.

post.description: The authenticated user ID is taken from the token. Email and password fields are server-controlled and must not be sent here. Backend 0.0.2 accepts avatarFile without coverFile; coverFile is an optional thumbnail.

200.description: Updated user profile.

post.summary: Search for a user or group
post.description: Searches by the contact ID. The result includes the relationship status visible to the current user.

200.description: Matching contact summary or a body-level business error.

post.summary: Apply to add a friend or join a group

applyInfo.description: Optional greeting, limited by the database column length.

200.description: Returns the target's join type when the request is accepted or recorded.
Paged contact applications ordered by the latest application time.

post.summary: Accept, reject, or block a contact application

200.description: Application handled; data is null.

post.summary: Load the current user's contacts or groups

200.description: Contact entries of the requested type.

post.summary: Read visible information for a contact
post.description: This operation may return a user who is not yet a friend, with contactStatus set to the non-friend value.

200.description: Visible contact profile.
Friend profile; non-friends receive a business error.
Contact removed; data is null.
Contact blocked; data is null.

post.summary: Create a group or update group information
post.description: groupId omitted creates a group; supplying groupId updates an existing group owned by the caller. A group avatar file is required by the current service when creating a group. The cover file is optional.

200.description: Group saved; data is null.

post.summary: Load groups created by the current user

200.description: The caller's active groups, ordered by creation time descending.
Group details including member count.

post.summary: Read group details and members for the chat page

200.description: Group details and active member list.
Group leave operation completed.

post.description: Only the group owner may perform this operation. selectContacts is a comma-separated list of user IDs; opType 0 removes members and 1 adds them.

200.description: Member operation completed.

post.description: Only the group owner may dissolve the group.

200.description: Group marked as dissolved; data is null.

post.description: Requires the admin role in addition to the token. The web contract exposes the fields used by the admin list and excludes password data.

post.summary: Enable or disable a user account
post.description: Requires the admin role.
Requires the admin role.
Requires the admin role.

post.description: Requires the admin role. The regular-user settings endpoint is /account/getSysSetting.

200.description: Current system settings.

post.description: Requires the admin role. Supply robotAvatarFile and robotAvatarCoverFile together when replacing the avatar.

post.summary: Load a paged list of reserved user IDs
post.description: Requires the admin role.

post.summary: Create or update a reserved user ID
post.description: Requires the admin role.
Requires the admin role.

post.summary: Create or update an app release
post.description: Requires the admin role. file is needed when fileType is 0; outerLink is used for fileType 1.
Requires the admin role.

post.summary: Publish or stage an app update
post.description: Requires the admin role. status 0 is draft, 1 is gray release, and 2 is full release.

post.summary: Check for a published app update
post.description: Requires a valid token but not the admin role. When version is omitted or empty, the server returns an empty success response.

200.description: Update information, null when no version was supplied or no update is available, or a business error.

post.summary: Upload a message file and optional cover image

200.description: Upload completed.

post.summary: Download an attachment, cover, or avatar
post.description: The request must be authenticated; message files also require conversation membership. Backend 0.0.2 returns the full application/octet-stream stream and does not implement HTTP Range requests. Validation and authorization errors are handled by the standard business-error response before streaming starts; an I/O failure after streaming starts can terminate the connection.

fileId.description: Numeric message ID for message files; non-numeric avatar/group IDs for avatars.

200.description: Full binary file response; no Range semantics are currently implemented.

default.description: Download error serialization is not consistent in the current backend implementation.

post.description: The web text composer supports messageType 2 and limits messages to 500 characters. The backend validates contact membership and persists the message before returning this response.

200.description: Saved message and generated conversation metadata.

post.description: Returns up to 50 messages. Omit beforeMessageId to load the latest page; when supplied, it is an exclusive cursor and older messages are returned in chronological order. The default page size is 30.

200.description: Conversation page. The service verifies the caller's membership before returning messages.

tokenHeader.name: token
tokenHeader.description: Current transitional token header used by the backend. Public production deployment still requires the planned secure-cookie and short-lived WebSocket-ticket design.

BusinessError.description: Business or transport error. The backend commonly returns application errors with HTTP 200 and a non-200 body code. Common body codes include 500, 600, 601, 901, 902, and 903.

NullOperationResult.description: The operation completed without a data payload or returned a body-level business error.

AdminUserPageResult.description: Admin user page or body-level business error.

AdminGroupPageResult.description: Admin group page or body-level business error.

BeautyAccountPageResult.description: Beauty-account page or body-level business error.

AppUpdatePageResult.description: App update page or body-level business error.

data.description: Endpoint-specific payload; null for no-payload operations.

check_code.description: PNG data URI for the arithmetic captcha.

check_code_key.description: One-time captcha key; expires after ten minutes.

password.description: Raw password sent to the server, which hashes it. Must contain at least one letter and one digit.
Lowercase MD5 digest of the raw password, matching the legacy desktop-client protocol.

token.description: Present on successful login; not used by profile reads.

maxImageSize.description: Backend setting; unit is defined by the current server implementation.

maxVideoSize.description: Backend setting; unit is defined by the current server implementation.

maxFileSize.description: Backend setting; unit is defined by the current server implementation.

AdminUserQuery.description: The web contract includes safe admin-list filters only; password filters are intentionally excluded.

AdminUserInfo.description: Safe fields used by the admin user list. Backend 0.0.2 marks the password field write-only, and the backend serialization test confirms it is omitted from JSON.

createTime.description: Formatted local time, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, GMT+8.

updateTime.description: Formatted local time, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, GMT+8.

groupId.description: Omit to create a group; include to update an owned group.

avatarFile.description: Required by the service when creating a group; optional on update.

createTime.description: Formatted local time, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, GMT+8.

memberCount.description: The chat detail endpoint may leave this null; use userContactList.length instead.

contactId.description: Recipient user ID for a one-to-one chat.

messageType.description: 2 is a text message in the current web slice.

contactId.description: Other participant's user ID for a direct chat.

beforeMessageId.description: Exclusive cursor; omit to load the newest page.
